models.name: tomato_dnabert_6mer_classifier
models.notes: Tomato fine-tuned 6-mer DNABERT checkpoint used by predict-dnabert.

models.name: pregan_expression_constraint_denselstm
models.notes: Expression-constraint checkpoint used during preGAN generator training; not the generator itself.

models.name: transvae_tomato_historical_compatible_predictor
models.architecture: Transformer-VAE encoder with 128-dimensional latent representation and four-output MLP predictor
models.source_convention: historical checkpoint-compatible token slicing and attention mask
models.notes: Default release scorer for model-consistent historical inference. This compatibility route is distinct from the corrected full-length development checkpoint.

models.name: transvae_tomato_joint_predictor
models.architecture: Transformer-VAE encoder with full 165-bp input, 128-dimensional latent representation and four-output MLP predictor
models.source_convention: full-length A/C/G/T input with no nucleotide token aliased to padding
models.notes: Full-length joint checkpoint trained with the released Transformer-VAE objective; validation/test metrics must be reported separately from the historical checkpoint evaluation.

models.name: tomato_pregan_conditional_generator
models.training_split: original loader 80/20 partition of merged_result.csv; 4,080 records used for checkpoint fitting
models.notes: Original thesis preGAN architecture migrated from deepseed and trained on the 80% split of merged_result.csv: 10,000 generator iterations, five critic updates per generator update, L1 weight 50 and frozen DenseNet-LSTM fruit predictor. Biological validation remains required.
